title: Hospitality Management: Hotel Fundamentals
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Hospitality Management: Hotel Fundamentals - Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Students will define and apply industry-specific terminology to real-world scenarios in the hospitality field.
Students will analyze and explain the interrelations between various hotel departments and their contributions to operational success.
Students will demonstrate effective verbal and written communication skills tailored to hospitality environments.
Students will apply human resource management practices, including recruitment, hiring, and performance evaluation, to simulated hospitality operations.
Students will evaluate the historical development of lodging operations and its relevance to current industry practices.
Students will engage respectfully with diverse populations, showcasing cultural awareness and adaptability in professional settings.
Students will integrate operational strategies to enhance guest satisfaction and ensure efficiency in hospitality services.

blocks.name: Requirements for the Certificate of Achievement (CA)
